objective: Architecture specifications for framework-agnostic state management, comparing React 19 Server Actions, Next.js App Router, Astro Islands, and client-side reactive Signals under high-frequency stream hydration.

key_findings: Fine-grained reactive signals (Nanostores, Preact Signals) update streamed component DOM nodes in <1.2ms without triggering parent re-renders.
Astro Islands architecture isolates AI generative widgets into zero-JS static HTML containers with selective client hydration.
React 19 `useActionState` and optimistic UI hooks reconcile server-rendered streaming updates with client user input safely.
Bi-directional state sync between client reactive stores and remote agent working memory requires transactional sequence numbering.
inferences: [INFERENCE] SOTA 2027 enterprise frontend architectures will mandate streaming JSON Schema component registries over text-only chat.
[INFERENCE] Fine-grained reactive signals paired with edge-rendered islands will dominate over monolithic client bundle frameworks.
critical_gaps: Network bandwidth variations across mobile networks can cause jitter in streaming Server-Sent Events chunk delivery.
Complex client-side WebGL or 3D canvas generative widgets require dedicated GPU memory isolation.
